vector_identity: Captured original digest/build/engine plus every exact retained command/source/outcome/publication dependency. Corrected source, definition, fee, calendar, FX and engine revisions remain vector changes, not new lock scopes.
overlap: An intersecting frozen dependency cannot change through another window. A wider window needs its own captured original. Alternate overlapping partitions refuse. Changed dependencies atomically stale ordinary dependent projections; an atomic bundle must supply every complete replacement.
idempotency: Trusted tenant + operation + logical UUID; identical content returns the first retained receipt, conflicting content returns409. Transport lineage is excluded. Apply retries preserve original decision after subsequent transitions.
temporal: COMMITTED_TOKEN identifies one retained complete decision snapshot. No arbitrary wall-clock as-known reconstruction or backfilled approval history. Exact/as-reported responses preserve historical original; current-use restrictions are explicit.
authority: Verified bearer principal and current trusted grants are required. A separate exact-content financial-purpose verification boundary defaults unavailable. Configured signed synthetic conformance is always SYNTHETIC_NON_CERTIFYING and cannot establish institutional activation. Membership/method/source receipts are not financial approval.
impact: The digest-bound local graph identifies retained result dependencies. Report versions, recipients and institutional materiality remain UNAVAILABLE when no qualified input exists, never inferred zero.
compatibility: Existing calculated latest-corrected/greatest-sequence behavior and incomplete-newest refusal are unchanged. Existing explicit TWR and candidate originals keep their serializers/digests. New authority read defaults LATEST_APPROVED selected decision; it never falls back to calculated candidates.
